description: This file defines the CacheManager class responsible for managing a cache of file hashes for code indexing within a VS Code extension. It includes methods for initializing, saving, clearing, and updating the cache, as well as handling errors and telemetry.

classes.name: CacheManager
classes.description: Manages a cache of file hashes for code indexing, providing methods to initialize, save, clear, and update cache data, with error handling and telemetry integration.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes a new CacheManager with VS Code extension context and workspace path, setting up cache path and debounce function.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Loads cache data from disk into memory, with error handling and telemetry reporting.

methods.name: _performSave
methods.description: Saves the current cache state to disk, with error handling and telemetry.

methods.name: clearCacheFile
methods.description: Clears the cache file by writing an empty object, resetting in-memory cache.

methods.name: getHash
methods.description: Retrieves the hash for a given file path.

methods.name: updateHash
methods.description: Updates the hash for a specific file path and triggers a debounced save.

methods.name: deleteHash
methods.description: Deletes the hash entry for a specific file path and triggers a debounced save.

methods.name: getAllHashes
methods.description: Returns a copy of all stored file hashes.
